# Captain v2 Current Status

Last updated: 2026-03-13

## Purpose
This is the rolling handoff file for quick resume. Update this file after each meaningful firmware, wiring, or workflow change.

## Firmware Snapshot
- Project folder: Captain-v2
- Default environment: captain_control
- Upload method in active use: USB serial on COM5
- Attract loop: enabled

## Attract Timing (Current)
- Total sweep: 1000 ms
- Slot per lamp: 100 ms
- Lamp ON: 50 ms
- Lamp OFF: 50 ms
- Laps: 1

## Audio Bring-Up (Current)
- I2S output path enabled on DIN=25, BCLK=14, LRCK=13.
- Wiring note: suspected BCLK/LRCK crossing seen in probes, but swap is NOT committed as default until physical routing is confirmed.
- Temporary bypass test: LRCK remapped to GPIO15 to avoid suspected GPIO13 signal-path failure.
- Hardware isolation result: GPIO15 LRCK is clean at source; when jumpered onto the LRCK net tied to MAX98357 path, waveform collapses into spikes/noise.
- Conclusion: LRCK net is being heavily loaded; most likely failed MAX98357 input stage or local board damage on that net.
- Startup audio test sequence is enabled at boot.
- Test pattern: 392 Hz, 523 Hz, 659 Hz, 784 Hz.
- Pattern repeats: 2 passes.
- Tone duration: 100 ms each.
- Inter-tone gap: 35 ms.
- Serial markers expected:
	- Audio test: startup pattern begin
	- Audio test: startup pattern complete

## Expected Boot Signatures
- CAPTAIN_V2 setup start
- Attract config: enabled=1 period=1000 minStep=20 laps=1
- Attract timing: slot=100ms on=50ms off=50ms sweep=1000ms laps=1

## Known-Good Upload Command
```powershell
cd "c:\Users\user\Esp32 projects VScode\Captain-Fantastic-home-edition\Captain-v2"
C:\Users\user\.platformio\penv\Scripts\platformio.exe run -e captain_control -t upload --upload-port COM5
```

## Known Issues
1. Matrix I2C device at 0x24 has been missing in some boot sessions.
2. Tilt input on GPIO34 is noisy/floating and can spam pressed/released logs.
3. Root project upload task combined_rtos is not the preferred path for Captain-v2 control firmware.

## Resume Checklist
- [ ] Confirm folder is Captain-v2
- [ ] Upload captain_control on COM5
- [ ] Confirm monitor is not occupying COM5 during upload
- [ ] Verify expected boot signature lines
- [ ] Confirm attract sweep cadence on hardware
